task_description: Agents collaborate to develop a software component. They need to write code based on specified requirements, review and test the code, and fix any bugs before integrating the changes into the main branch.
expected_outcome: The agents should successfully develop the software component, identify and fix any bugs during the code review and testing phases, and finally integrate the changes without any conflicts.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for interpreting the requirements and writing the initial code.
This agent reviews the code written by the Developer to identify any issues or bugs.
This agent tests the code to ensure it meets the requirements and is free of bugs.

content.comments: Code looks good, minor refactoring suggested.
